# BBN Community

> BBN Community is a collaborative platform for sharing articles, managing contributor guidelines, and maintaining transparent policies on privacy, data protection, and community standards.

BBN Community focuses on community-driven content creation with clear submission guidelines, privacy protections, and advertising partnerships. The platform emphasizes contributor engagement and data security through comprehensive policies.

## Key Topics

- article submission
- contributor guidelines
- community content
- privacy policy
- data protection
- author requirements
- personally identifiable information
- third-party advertising
- data collection
- security measures
- newsletter subscription
- terms and conditions
- Adsense
- Revcontent
- Audience Network

## Content Submission & Guidelines

- [Submit an Article](https://www.bbncommunity.com/submit-an-article): Guidelines for submitting articles to BBN Community, including author requirements and community content standards

## Policies & Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.bbncommunity.com/privacy-policy): BBN Community privacy policy covering data collection, personally identifiable information protection, and data security measures
